s-brand.text:
Rule: product screens (marketing site, dashboard, editor) use only --lv-* tokens, light and dark.

Creator sites use only --site-* tokens, set from each creator's own brand. The orange 'Desi Origins' brand is a sample.

s-marketing.text:
From BuildBase, not redesigned:
• Beta signup form (BetaForm) and approved-waitlist access
• Hosted sign-in and sign-up pages
• Cookie banner and consent

Ours: this landing page only.

s-dashboard.text:
From BuildBase, not redesigned:
• Workspace switcher (one workspace = one site)
• Members, invites, roles and permissions
• Account, profile, security, sessions
• Plans, billing, credits and invoices
• Products, files and releases editor (ItemEditor, SellerItems)
• Sales and orders (SellerSales, SellerHome)
• Stripe Connect seller onboarding

Ours: site overview, inbox, short links, handle and domain settings.

s-editor.text:
All ours: Insert panel (sections, components, pages), preview on three devices, properties panel, theme, draft autosave, preview link, publish and version history.

On phones the panels stack under the preview.

Products picked inside a block come from BuildBase items.

s-site.text:
Creator sites use the creator's own brand (--site-* tokens), not Levuche colours. Shown: the sample 'Desi Origins' brand in light and dark.

From BuildBase, not redesigned:
• Stripe checkout and payment
• Order page downloads (HoldingFiles, licence keys)
• Receipt and order emails
• Form storage (Forms into Collections)

t-components.text: Source components (frames on other pages reuse these)

t-atoms.text: 1 · Atoms: smallest parts that can't be broken down

t-organisms.text: 3 · Organisms: distinct sections of an interface

s-atomic.text:
Atomic design (Brad Frost): atoms → molecules → organisms → templates → pages.

Every level uses only tokens: --lv-* for Levuche screens, --site-* for creator sites. Each artboard shows light and dark.

Pages = the device frames on the '5 · Page' tabs.
